text: Control Command Upgrade — live dashboard, appliance board presentation, station grouping, resource request tab, incident timeline, and shift handover summary.
Control configuration — uploaded Config.Callsigns, Config.AlertVehicles and Config.CallSignStations kept exactly as supplied.

SatNav 2.0 — Added an expanded offline map system with live GPS position, follow mode, map styles, search, GIS grid layer, route/measure tools, north arrow, scale bar, live GPS status and improved map controls.
Update History — Added a full in-game Update History tab opened from SatNav Admin Menu, matching the history stored in the resource files.
Update History — Added a persistent MDT update history showing date, time and work completed.
Keyboard shortcuts — F4 opens the MDT and F6 opens Control. Existing /getec and /control commands remain available.
Messaging — Control and MDT messages now use one shared conversation.
Pager — Pager popup and Enter-to-close behaviour fixed.
Incident alerts — Incidents continue to arrive on the MDT when the alert sound is disabled.
Control appliance list — Callsigns now synchronise correctly with Control.
Admin Menu — Battery Status, Screen Settings and About panels restored.
